title: Composition controls
description: Standard-owned `controls` collection for composition documents (MapPackage/AppPackage). A control is an input affordance the user operates; it emits the `change` event of the ADR-0030 interaction vocabulary and is the target a `control:{id}` reference resolves against. The kind vocabulary is closed — extending it requires a standard ADR — and deliberately excludes a feature-editing draw control (ADR-0028). Controls declare presentation and data binding only; behaviour is wired declaratively through the `interactions` block (common/interactions.schema.json). See docs/adr/0031-composition-controls.md.

controlKind.description: Closed control vocabulary. Map affordances: navigation (zoom/pan/compass), scale, fullscreen, geolocate, attribution, basemapSwitcher, bookmarks, measure, search. Data-binding affordances that emit `change`: timeSlider, filterSelect, filterSlider, filterDateRange, opacity. There is deliberately no feature-editing draw kind — autonomous agent mutation of source records stays excluded (ADR-0028); an annotation-only draw control may be admitted later by its own ADR. Extending this set requires a standard ADR (ADR-0031).

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the document's controls block. `control:{id}` references in the interactions and layout blocks resolve against this value; add_control replaces an existing control with the same id.

kind.description: What the control is. The kind fixes the affordance's semantics, not its skin — hosts render each kind in their own idiom.

title.description: Human-readable label shown by the host. Optional; hosts fall back to a per-kind default label.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the layer or datasource the control reads its domain from (e.g. the layer whose field values populate a filterSelect, or the layer a timeSlider ranges over). Data-binding kinds normally set it; presentation-only kinds (navigation, scale, fullscreen, attribution) omit it. Resolution of the identifier within the document is a validation-gate responsibility, as for layer references.

config.description: Per-kind configuration (e.g. the field a filterSelect filters on, a slider's bounds and step, a bookmark list). Host-interpreted and intentionally open, matching the widget entry's `config`; it carries no expression language and grants no capability the composition surface does not already have.

control.description: One control entry. The shape mirrors the composition widget entry ({ id, kind, title?, sourceId?, config? }) so agents author both collections the same way.

controls.description: Input affordances declared by this composition document. Optional and additive: a document without controls is valid. Ids must be unique within the collection (validation-gate check).
